propositions: Pandoc subprocess spawning costs ~0.3s per field, blocking serial reconcile on fork+exec; batching contiguous _RENDER units into single pandoc invocations reduces spawn count.

Pathological corpus bodies drive pandoc jira reader to hang (13.5 min at 95.8% CPU); pypandoc sets no timeout and does not expose process handle, so grandchild survives subprocess.run timeout reaping.
Hard caller-side timeout via proc.communicate(timeout=dc_pandoc_timeout_s) with process-group reaping via rebar._proc.reap_process_group is required to kill CPU-spinning pandoc grandchildren.

Dangerous units that corrupt pandoc jira reader pass through verbatim with no pandoc invocation; segment-level fallback on timeout, non-zero exit, or preservation check failure degrades entire safe run to original Markdown.
pypandoc-binary wheel must be pinned by version in pyproject.toml, pin verified in CI, and GPL license recorded in SBOM/notice.
